description: Signatures of Elci's compiler-provided functions that have no Elci source: the Bytes, Julc.Data and Debug modules, the Basics intrinsics (not, modBy, remainderBy and the ^ operator) and the built-in constructors. Basics, List, Maybe, Result, String, Tuple, Dict, Map and Array are Elci source modules bundled with the compiler; Expect, Scenario and Property are the test library. Every module imports Basics exposing (..), List, Maybe exposing (Maybe(..)), Result exposing (Result(..)), String, Tuple and Debug by default, as in Elm. Every signature was type-checked with the Elci CLI.

modules.summary: Byte-string builtins; each function is a direct Plutus builtin call with the byte string as the last argument. The type Bytes is built in and needs no import. Compare byte strings with ==, and order them with <, <=, >, >=, compare, min and max (lexicographic by unsigned byte, a proper prefix first); there is no Bytes.lessThan.

functions.name: empty
functions.summary: The empty byte string.

functions.name: fromString
functions.summary: UTF-8 encoding of a string (builtin encodeUtf8).

functions.name: toString
functions.summary: UTF-8 decoding (builtin decodeUtf8); fails the script on invalid UTF-8.

functions.name: length
functions.summary: Number of bytes.

functions.name: append
functions.summary: append a b is a followed by b. In a pipeline, x |> Bytes.append p gives p followed by x.

functions.name: slice
functions.summary: slice start count bytes: count bytes from start (a length, not an end index); clamps to the available bytes.

functions.name: take
functions.summary: The first n bytes; clamps.

functions.name: drop
functions.summary: All but the first n bytes; clamps.

functions.name: at
functions.summary: The byte (0-255) at a 0-based index; fails the script outside the byte string.

functions.name: cons
functions.summary: Prepends one byte; fails the script outside 0-255.

functions.name: replicate
functions.summary: replicate count byte; fails outside 0-255 or above 8192 bytes.

functions.name: fromIntBigEndian
functions.summary: fromIntBigEndian width n: n in exactly width bytes, big-endian; width 0 means minimal; fails for negative n, if n does not fit, or width above 8192.

functions.name: fromIntLittleEndian
functions.summary: As fromIntBigEndian, little-endian.

functions.name: toIntBigEndian
functions.summary: Unsigned big-endian integer; the empty byte string is 0.

functions.name: toIntLittleEndian
functions.summary: Unsigned little-endian integer.

functions.name: and
functions.summary: Bitwise AND, truncated to the shorter operand.

functions.name: or
functions.summary: Bitwise OR, truncated to the shorter operand.

functions.name: xor
functions.summary: Bitwise XOR, truncated to the shorter operand.

functions.name: complement
functions.summary: Flips every bit.

functions.name: shift
functions.summary: Shifts bits towards the front for positive n, towards the end for negative n; same length, shifted-out bits are lost.

functions.name: rotate
functions.summary: Like shift, but bits wrap around.

functions.name: testBit
functions.summary: Reads bit i; bit 0 is the least significant bit of the last byte.

functions.name: countSetBits
functions.summary: Number of 1 bits.

functions.name: findFirstSetBit
functions.summary: Index of the lowest set bit, or -1 when no bit is set.

functions.name: blake2b224
functions.summary: BLAKE2b-224 digest (28 bytes, the size of key and script hashes).

functions.name: blake2b256
functions.summary: BLAKE2b-256 digest (32 bytes).

functions.name: sha256
functions.summary: SHA2-256 digest (32 bytes).

functions.name: sha3_256
functions.summary: SHA3-256 digest (32 bytes).

functions.name: keccak256
functions.summary: Keccak-256 digest (32 bytes).

functions.name: ripemd160
functions.summary: RIPEMD-160 digest (20 bytes).

modules.summary: Explicit conversions between Elci values and Plutus Data, and adapters between Julc optionals and Maybe. The types Data and JulcOptional are built in.

functions.name: decode
functions.summary: Julc's strict decoder for the concrete type a: checks tags, arity and fields; malformed Data fails the script (never a Maybe), and so does a Dict whose keys are not strictly ascending or a Value that is not canonical. a must be known where it is used; annotate when inference cannot tell. Rejected (ELCI3003) for (), functions, Array, TxOut and types that contain a Value; a Value itself decodes.

functions.name: encode
functions.summary: The Data encoding of a value: records are constructor 0 with fields sorted by name, union variants use declaration-order tags, Maybe is Nothing 0 / Just 1, tuples are constructor 0, lists are lists, maps are maps. Result is Ok 0 / Err 1. A Value is its own Data map, at no cost. Accepts a type nothing determines, such as that of Nothing or []. Rejected for (), functions, Array, and lists and tuples of Values.

functions.name: fromOptional
functions.summary: Re-tags a Julc optional (Some 0, None 1), as returned by Java libraries, into an Elci Maybe (Nothing 0, Just 1).

functions.name: toOptional
functions.summary: The reverse adapter: Elci Maybe to Julc optional.

functions.name: trace
functions.summary: Emits the message as a Plutus trace and returns the second argument. Both arguments are evaluated first (strict), so a failing second argument emits nothing; costs budget and script bytes. There is no Debug.log, Debug.toString or Debug.todo.

modules.summary: The compiler intrinsics of the Basics prelude. The rest of Basics (negate, abs, min, max, clamp, compare, Order(LT, EQ, GT), identity, always, xor) is Elci source, listed with the bundled modules. Every module imports Basics exposing (..), so these names need no qualifier; Basics.not and the like also work, and a module's own declaration of the same name shadows them.

functions.name: not
functions.summary: Boolean negation.

functions.name: modBy
functions.summary: modBy divisor value: result has the divisor's sign (Elm semantics); modBy 3 -7 is 2. Fails the script for divisor 0.

functions.name: remainderBy
functions.summary: remainderBy divisor value: result has the value's sign (Elm semantics); remainderBy 3 -7 is -1. Fails the script for divisor 0.
Integer power operator: 2 ^ 10 is 1024. Right-associative, binds tighter than * (precedence 8); a negative exponent fails the script. Usable as a function, (^) 2 10.

modules.summary: Constructors built into the compiler; Just and Nothing are exposed through the default import Maybe exposing (Maybe(..)). A module may not declare constructors with these names, or types named Int, Bool, String, Bytes, Data, List, Maybe, Dict, Map, Array or Float.
